description: Get usage help for Lex MCP tools including examples, required fields, related tools, and common workflows. Use this to understand how to use Lex tools effectively.

examples.description: Include executable examples in the response (default: true)

format.description: Output format: 'full' (default) or 'micro' for ultra-compact examples

tool.description: Tool name to get help for (optional - returns all tools if omitted). Canonical names: atlas_analyze, contradictions_scan, db_stats, destination_inspect, frame_create, frame_get, frame_list, frame_search, frame_validate, help, hints_get, policy_check, system_introspect, timeline_show, turncost_calculate. Deprecated aliases are also accepted: remember, lex_remember, validate_remember, lex_validate_remember, recall, lex_recall, get_frame, lex_get_frame, list_frames, lex_list_frames, lex_policy_check, timeline, lex_timeline, code_atlas, lex_code_atlas, introspect, lex_introspect, get_hints, lex_help.

name: help
